supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records show a 640,000,000-byte outbound proxy transfer from FILE-BLU-01 to ingest.cloudkeep-backup.com beginning at 13:50:08 UTC, not around the alert’s stated 13:46 UTC time.

That 13:50 transfer is consistent with the approved backup service: Cloudkeep’s agent ran as svc-arch with a Nightly job targeting ingest.cloudkeep-backup.com, and the agent’s network activity is recorded through the proxy.
At 13:46:37, taskhostw.exe ran as SYSTEM from svchost.exe; the supplied records do not establish that this process performed the alerted large outbound transfer.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied evidence does not link the alert’s approximately 13:46 timestamp to the observed Cloudkeep transfer at 13:50:08 UTC.
Winsec collection from DC-BLU-01 was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:00 UTC, limiting corroboration of domain authentication activity during that interval.
claims_not_established: Whether the 13:50 Cloudkeep transfer is the specific network flow that triggered the alert.
Whether any large outbound transfer occurred around 13:46 UTC; the provided records do not identify one.
What files or data were included in the Cloudkeep transfer.
additional_evidence_needed: The original alert’s precise flow start/end time, destination, byte counts, and flow identifier, to correlate it with the 13:50 Cloudkeep transfer.
Network-flow or proxy records covering the alert’s exact time, and endpoint file-access or backup-job records that identify the transferred data.
unrelated_findings: FILE-BLU-01 attempted a curl/7.88.1 connection to the unapproved downloads.cloud.com service; the proxy denied it. Handle separately from this alert. (T220-00349, T220-00350)
PROXY-BLU-01 attempted SMB authentication to FILE-BLU-01 as svc_mgmt, which failed because the account was disabled. Handle separately from this alert. (T220-00469, T220-00470)
